executiveSummary: The tech industry is witnessing significant developments in AI, hardware, and industry shifts, with a focus on improving user experience and efficiency. Major trends include the increasing adoption of AI in various industries, the release of new hardware products, and changes in pricing strategies. Additionally, there are concerns over privacy and security, particularly with the rise of AI-powered assistants.

takeaways.title: AI adoption increasing
takeaways.description: Apple's AI-powered shopping assistant is being rolled out to select users as part of an 'Early Preview', indicating a growing focus on AI in the tech industry.

worthWatching: The expansion of robotaxis and the pushback against the rules governing them
The announcement of The Witcher 4's target release window of 2028
engineeringPerspective: The use of Apple Intelligence in Safari's new features, such as automatic tab organization and custom extensions
The potential for AI agents to be used in various industries, including robotics and healthcare
